name: Height and Weight Limits for Trucks and Large Vehicles

columns.name: route_id
columns.description: Identification number for each route restriction.

columns.name: reporting_agency
columns.description: Agency that the data are coming from.

columns.name: restriction_description
columns.description: Restriction’s address and what kind of restriction it is. Some restrictions do not have specific addresses; the other columns will define the locations of these restrictions.

columns.name: start_road_name
columns.description: Name of the road where the restriction begins.

columns.name: start_cross_street
columns.description: Name of the nearest cross street where the restriction begins.

columns.name: end_road_name
columns.description: Name of the road where the restriction ends.

columns.name: end_cross_street
columns.description: Name of the nearest cross street where the restriction ends.

columns.name: restriction_category
columns.description: Type of restriction - height or weight.

columns.name: clearance_value
columns.description: Posted height for the vehicle to pass under the structure.

columns.name: applicable_truck_class
columns.description: Truck class associated with the restriction (if applicable).

columns.name: restriction_location_description
columns.description: Additional information about the location.

columns.name: load_posting
columns.description: Posted weight limit for the vehicle to pass through the facility.

columns.name: facility_type
columns.description: Type of the Restriction: If the restriction is Weight, or Boulevard.

columns.name: facility_name
columns.description: Name of the structure that is weight restricted (bridge name, overpass location, etc.).

columns.name: start_latitude
columns.description: Latitude of the start location.

columns.name: start_longitude
columns.description: Longitude of the start location.

columns.name: end_latitude
columns.description: Latitude of the end location.

columns.name: end_longitude
columns.description: Longitude of the end location.

columns.name: start_location
columns.description: Start location in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal

columns.name: end_location
columns.description: End location in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
